description: Change a column after the fact: rename it, change its type (e.g. number -> currency), replace settings (dropdown options), or set isRequired / isHidden. A type change converts existing values (number↔currency, text→number/date/checkbox, anything→text) and clears the ones that cannot convert; the response carries conversion: { converted, cleared }. settings.validation rules apply here too.

isHidden.description: Hide the column in the TaskLite UI

isRequired.description: Require a non-blank value on every App API create

settings.description: Replaces the column settings, e.g. { options: [...] } for dropdown/status

type.description: New column type (same list as create_column)

name: update_column
